heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sub: Clear answers about the Learning Commons, admission, and how classes run in Chamba.

items.question: What launch tracks and entrance exams are covered?
items.answer: We offer four launch tracks: PCM (JEE Main/Advanced, IAT, NEST, CUET PCM, NDA, AIIMS Paramedical PCM), PCB (NEET UG, AIIMS Nursing, AIIMS Paramedical PCB, NEST, IAT, CUET PCB), CUET UG General Test + English, and CUET UG Arts/Commerce + NDA Army.

items.question: What is the daily schedule and weekly rhythm?
items.answer: Classes run Monday to Saturday, from 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM. Each student attends five days a week, with one rotating weekday off, and Sunday off.

items.question: What are the fees?
items.answer: Fees are shared when you enquire. We do not publish fee figures or take online payments on this site.

items.question: What is the entrance baseline for children?
items.answer: The entrance baseline is a short diagnostic on reasoning, reading and arithmetic. It is running now. It places learners so guides know where to begin; it never excludes anyone.

items.question: How are classes conducted inside the centre?
items.answer: Students learn in small groups with a guide who knows every student. Instead of one-way lectures, sessions use a flip-slot model where concepts are introduced and students solve problems with immediate guidance. Every class ends with a practice test on what was just taught, and doubts are solved in a separate short session.

items.question: How does admission work?
items.answer: Submit an enquiry on this site or message us on WhatsApp at 8287248119. The centre owner calls back personally {callbackWindow} to discuss your learning goals and arrange a visit to the centre behind the Post Office in Chamba.

items.question: What is Corteon and is it available now?
items.answer: Corteon is the AI tutor and practice engine Synapse is building. Its status is in development (DIRECTION) and it is not available to the public. In our classrooms, the no-device quiz run by humans always wins.
